**Easiest: [get it from the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MV9P36W441C)**: no warning, automatic updates.

**Or download `EzDesk.zip` below**, then:

1. Right-click the zip → **Properties** → tick **Unblock** → **OK**
2. Right-click the zip → **Extract All…** → pick your **Documents** folder
3. Open the folder and double-click **EzDesk.exe**
4. No numbered icon near the clock? Click **^** and drag it onto the taskbar
5. Right-click the icon → **Start with Windows**

**New in 1.4.1**

- **A mini-dock on the tray number.** Rest the mouse on the number: your desktops appear with their wallpaper and live previews. Click one to go there, **×** to close it, **+** for a new one, drag to reorder them (Windows 11 24H2+), right-click to rename one or choose its background.
- **Drops of light on the screen edges.** Hold a window by its title bar: a drop of light clings to each side of the screen. Bring the window to an edge and the drop grows, with the number of the desktop you'd land on next to it. Hold it there and it fills with white, then you slide to that desktop with the window in hand.
- **A bigger desktop number.** The tray number now fills its whole slot, in white, and rolls up or down when you change desktop.
- **Windows' own settings, one click away.** The menu options for showing the icon on the taskbar and for showing apps from all desktops open the right Windows Settings page, and EzDesk lights up the option to change there.
- **Native on Windows 11 24H2+**, no extra library needed there. Older Windows keeps working as before.
- The original EzDesk logo is back.

Updating from the zip: "Start with Windows" carries over by itself.

If Windows says *"Windows protected your PC"*: **More info** → **Run anyway**. The exe isn't code-signed. This zip was built by GitHub Actions from this repository's code; its SHA256 is in `EzDesk.zip.sha256`.

Power users: admin mode (also works with admin windows) is in the zip's `admin\` folder. See the [README](https://github.com/alxbdn/ezdesk#power-users-admin-mode).
